title: Quark Dust Ladder
setting: Hadron cloud with loose quark flecks and slow charge streams around a dense central knot.
food: Quark flecks, proton knots, neutron-rich nuclei.
interaction: Opposite charges pull quarks together; goo rolls through, gathering flecks and nudging knots toward the center.
parts: Goo nibbles accessible quarks, grows enough to eat intact protons, then consumes nuclei as a cartoon parts-to-whole payoff.
risk: Binding must read without implying measured sizes.

title: Charge-Tier Drift
setting: A three-color particle cloud spreads across one open field, with dense and sparse streams crossing.
food: Small charge beads, medium composite blobs, large bound clusters.
interaction: Density gradients pull each species toward compatible clusters; larger blobs bend smaller streams, while goo rolls along a side current and gathers the loose tier.
parts: Charge beads bind into larger composite clusters.
risk: Three simultaneous streams may blur scale cues.

title: Photon Pair Drift
setting: A photon cloud crosses a dark field where paired light beads form and separate along a faint energy ridge.
food: Photon flecks, paired light beads, dense energy knots.
interaction: An energy ripple splits and reunites pairs; goo rolls across the ridge, collecting loose photons and bending the next pair toward its wake.
jumps: View widens to reveal the ridge's second crossing.
risk: Bright particle paths need readable silhouettes.

title: Nucleus Binding Wake
setting: A neutron halo surrounds proton beads in a shifting field, with small nucleon clusters drifting along the outer wake.
food: Loose neutrons, proton beads, bound nucleon clusters, compact nuclei.
interaction: Binding fields draw particles together; goo rolls through the halo, peeling accessible beads from the wake before larger clusters settle behind it.
parts: Goo nibbles loose nucleons, grows into clusters, then eats intact nuclei.
risk: Nucleon layers need clear growth cues.

title: Vacuum Dust Current
setting: Loose dirt-like quanta drift through a quiet vacuum pocket, separated by a broad pressure ripple.
food: Dust quanta, compact dust knots, heavy vacuum pearls.
interaction: The ripple pushes quanta toward a low-pressure pocket; goo occupies the pocket, slowing the flow and making knots collect along its edge.
risk: A nearly empty field may lack strong landmarks.

title: Three-Stream Color Fold
setting: Three colored particle streams fold over one another inside a soft charge gradient.
food: Colored beads, paired states, dense tricolor knots.
interaction: Crossing streams exchange momentum at overlap points; goo enters an overlap, trapping paired beads and leaving a dense knot behind.
jumps: The camera opens to show the streams' folded paths.
parts: Three compatible beads bind into a tricolor knot.
risk: Overlap feedback must be readable in cel shading.

title: Mineral Dust Strata
setting: A warm atomic dust pocket holds light clay-like grains over heavier silt-like clusters.
food: Light atoms, paired mineral grains, heavy silt clusters.
interaction: A slow density current lifts the lighter layer and leaves heavier clusters behind; goo rolls along the boundary, collecting a new ridge of grains.
risk: Similar grain shapes could flatten the progression.

title: Atom Colony Drift
setting: Three atom species occupy concentration clouds in one translucent gas pocket.
food: Small atom clusters, medium bonded groups, large dense clumps.
interaction: Charge attracts matching groups while flow pushes large clumps across smaller clouds; goo moves between layers and redirects a loose group.
jumps: View shows all three concentration clouds.
parts: Atom groups join where fields overlap.
risk: Binding needs simple visual language.

title: Red-White Current
setting: Red and pale atom clusters stream through a clear branching fluid pocket around a denser white cluster.
food: Red atom beads, bacterial atom knots, pale white clusters.
interaction: Flow splits at the fork; goo settles in one branch, slowing red clusters and exposing a side current where the pale cluster passes.
risk: Blood-inspired colors can be visually heavy.

title: Metal Vapor Shear
setting: Iron-rich and copper-rich atom clouds drift through a vapor pocket, separated by a magnetic gradient.
food: Metal atoms, paired grains, alloy clusters, metal beads.
interaction: The gradient pulls iron-rich grains sideways while vapor carries copper across; goo settles at the boundary, collecting atoms and redirecting the alloy stream.
parts: Loose atoms aggregate into soft density shells.
risk: Metal families need distinct silhouettes.

title: Reactive Atom Foam
setting: Light and heavy atom clouds mingle at a sparkling boundary where gas pockets fold into foam.
food: Light atom beads, paired gas bubbles, dense reactive clusters.
interaction: Pressure from the heavy cloud squeezes bubbles outward; goo blocks a narrow fold, forcing a pocket to bulge and shed clusters.
jumps: The view widens to reveal the pressure boundary behind the foam.
risk: Foam movement can hide which clusters are edible.

title: Crystal Lattice Pulse
setting: A crystal lattice of silicon-like atoms spans a clear field, with vacant gaps and dense nodes.
food: Loose atoms, lattice links, crystal nodes, atomic blocks.
interaction: A heat pulse expands a gap while bonds pull shut; goo occupies it, catching displaced atoms before the lattice reforms.
parts: Goo nibbles links, grows, then consumes the crystal node.
risk: Lattice motion needs simple deterministic motion.

title: Capillary Dirt Film
setting: A coherent wet mineral film lies over porous stone, carrying loose clay molecules and silt aggregates.
food: Mineral molecules, short aggregates, dense silt pellets.
interaction: Capillary flow draws material through pores; goo mops a local section, leaving the surrounding translucent film coherent while aggregates slide into reach.
parts: Goo nibbles exposed mineral molecules, grows into the aggregate, then consumes the intact clump.
risk: Local film removal must show a clean boundary.

title: Molecular Colony Wash
setting: Clear water film carries three molecule species in concentration bands, with larger colonies tucked in eddies.
food: Small molecules, paired clusters, colonies, large droplets.
interaction: Molecules bind on contact; goo presses one band, separating a cluster from its colony and sending it across the film.
jumps: Camera reveals the bands beyond the first eddy.
parts: Small molecules bind into larger droplets.
risk: Binding feedback may be too subtle.

title: Membrane Fork
setting: A flexible lipid sheet spans a watery pocket, with vesicle beads and protein channels opening along its folds.
food: Lipid beads, membrane patches, vesicles, folded sacs.
interaction: Vesicles drift through open channels; goo plugs one opening, redirecting them along the membrane edge and exposing a folded patch.
jumps: The view shifts to show the underside of the membrane fold.
risk: Thin surfaces need robust collision and camera readability.

title: Algae Polymer Wash
setting: Long sugar polymers trail through a slow molecular current beside compact pigment droplets and soft organic knots.
food: Sugar links, cellulose-like strands, pigment droplets, thick polymer bundles.
interaction: The current stretches strands around a bend; goo catches one strand, bunching it into a bundle while loose pigment follows the redirected flow.
parts: Sugar links join into longer polymer strands.
risk: Flexible strands may need visual simplification.

title: Puddle Molecule Mop
setting: A translucent puddle of water molecules spans a shallow groove, with mineral crumbs resting in its edge film.
food: Water molecules, mineral crumbs, droplet beads, coherent puddle lobes.
interaction: Surface tension pulls crumbs toward the low edge; goo consumes one local puddle section, leaving the remainder joined and translucent as crumbs settle.
jumps: A wider camera view reveals the connected puddle lobes beyond the first groove.
risk: Puddle continuity must survive local consumption.

title: Soap Film Fold
setting: Surfactant molecules line a thin film stretched between moist folds, forming bubbles of several sizes.
food: Surfactant beads, thin films, bubbles, foam caps.
interaction: Air pressure inflates weak pockets and ruptures thin skins; goo presses the film, steering stable bubbles toward a lower fold without clearing the whole surface.
risk: Bubble counts need strict caps.

title: Acid-Base Boundary
setting: Two clear molecular layers meet across a rippling boundary, where gas bubbles collect in a quiet pocket.
food: Acid droplets, base crystals, gas bubbles, foam beads.
interaction: Diffusion drives reaction along the boundary; goo shifts the interface, sending bubbles into a reachable pocket while both liquid layers remain coherent.
jumps: The camera opens to reveal the full boundary and its quiet bubble pocket.
risk: The proposed reaction needs harmless, readable cartoon language.

title: Peptide Knot Eddy
setting: Amino-acid chains drift through warm solvent, folding into loops around a slow eddy.
food: Amino-acid beads, short chains, folded knots, protein globes.
interaction: Solvent jostles chains; goo presses one loop, closing nearby bonds and pushing the knot into its feeding path.
jumps: Camera reveals folded globes beyond the eddy.
risk: Folding must read without full chemistry.

title: Soil Droplet Sidewash
setting: A microscopic soil droplet with clay grains, silt clusters, two side-fed currents, and dark soil walls.
food: Clay specks, larger silt clumps, compact soil lumps.
interaction: Side currents carry grains into the droplet; goo parks across one current, causing a local pileup while the other stream continues.
risk: Fine grains need silhouettes that read at the camera distance.

title: Pond Bacteria Loop
setting: A microscopic pond film with blue, pink, and green bacteria entering through opposite sides of clear water.
food: Small blue bacteria, pink bacteria, larger green bacteria, nutrient beads.
interaction: Cilia-like currents bend bacteria around a slow loop; goo rolls through the inner bend, feeding on the smallest tier while larger cells drift around it.
jumps: The camera widens to show the loop's second entry stream.
risk: Swimming paths need simple steering.

title: Capillary Red Drift
setting: A microscopic bloodstream cross-section with red cells, bacterial beads, and pale white cells moving through a forked capillary.
food: Red cells, green bacterial beads, pale white cells, plasma pearls.
interaction: Flow splits around the fork; goo settles on one wall, collecting red cells from the slower branch while white cells cross the opening.
risk: The scene must stay abstract and avoid medical claims.

title: Algae-and-Amoeba Pond
setting: A microscopic pond pocket with long algae chains, paramecia, and yellow and green amoebas moving between silt ridges.
food: Algae strands, paramecia, yellow amoebas, green amoebas.
interaction: A slow current carries algae along parallel ridges; goo follows one strand, then bends around a ridge to collect paramecia as amoebas change course.
jumps: A low camera reveal shows algae tracks continuing behind the silt ridge.
risk: Multiple moving lifeforms raise steering scope.

title: Lichen Crust Window
setting: A microscopic lichen crust on stone with clay dust, silt grains, fungal threads, and damp green patches.
food: Clay dust, silt grains, fungal beads, lichen clumps.
interaction: Moisture creeps through the crust and loosens grains; goo mops a damp patch, exposing fungal beads while the surrounding crust stays attached.
risk: Crust layers need clear depth cues.

title: Leaf Pore Microclimate
setting: A microscopic leaf underside with bacteria, wax ridges, pollen crumbs, and opening pores along a humid surface.
food: Bacteria specks, pollen crumbs, pore-film beads, thick leaf cells.
interaction: Humidity opens neighboring pores; goo covers one pore, redirecting vapor and carrying pollen toward a nearby ridge.
jumps: The view shifts beneath the wax ridge to reveal a second pore cluster.
risk: Pore changes may be too small to notice.

title: Capillary Mucus Bend
setting: A microscopic capillary wall with red cells, pale cells, mucus threads, and a sticky side pocket.
food: Red-cell beads, mucus droplets, bacterial knots, pale-cell clusters.
interaction: Flow presses cells against the bend; goo anchors on the mucus, peeling a local film and gathering red beads without removing the whole lining.
risk: Sticky wall contact needs careful movement tuning.

title: Amoeba Silt Basin
setting: A microscopic silt basin with algae ribbons, paramecia, and two amoeba sizes weaving through shallow clear water.
food: Algae ribbons, paramecia, small amoebas, large amoebas.
interaction: Ribbons sweep around a basin; goo crosses their wake, collecting algae and paramecia while amoebas redirect toward denser food.
jumps: The camera pulls back to reveal the basin's second algae lane.
risk: Amoeba redirection needs clear separation cues.

title: Bonsai Drain Soil
setting: Miniature soil ledge beside a bonsai planter, with dirt clumps below two leaves and side-entering aphids.
food: Small dirt clumps, large dirt clumps, aphids, ladybugs, bonsai leaves.
interaction: Aphids gather under leaves while ladybugs follow; sticky goo rolls through soil, then uses the loosened edge to reach each leaf.
jumps: The camera rises to reveal both bonsai leaves above the soil ledge.
risk: Moving insects and leaf collision need a compact build.

title: Pine-Needle Seed Slope
setting: A miniature garden slope littered with seeds and four pine needles, with a leaf-lined runout below.
food: Seeds, aphids, four pine needles, ladybugs, bonsai leaves, large flies.
interaction: Seeds settle in shallow grooves; goo rolls down the slope, collecting them before nudging needles into a bridge toward the insects.
risk: Long needles can catch the goo unless collision shapes stay forgiving.

title: Aphid Leaf Swarm
setting: A miniature bonsai canopy with a broad leaf underside, a dirt clump, and aphids streaming from both edges.
food: Aphids in escalating clusters, large dirt clumps, bonsai leaf.
interaction: Aphids funnel along the leaf vein; goo circles the underside, enlarging its capture area and gathering the stream without a clock.
jumps: The camera widens to show the full aphid loop around the leaf.
risk: A three-hundred-aphid objective needs capped, readable populations.

title: Seedpod Gutter
setting: Miniature garden gutter beneath a split seedpod, with damp husk flakes, sap beads, tiny roots, and a few ants.
food: Husk crumbs, sap beads, seed kernels, root bulbs.
interaction: Drizzle runs along the husk and drops kernels into a root pocket; goo rolls across the wet seam, catching crumbs and opening the pocket.
jumps: The camera dips under the seedpod to show the root pocket.
risk: Wet husk surfaces need forgiving collision.

title: Mossy Curb Bloom
setting: Miniature curbside moss patch with dew beads, seed husks, pale petals, and a shallow crack beside a rain-dark stone.
food: Dew beads, husk flakes, petals, moss cushions, stone crumbs.
interaction: Dew rolls into the crack while petals collect on moss; goo mops one wet section, leaving the film coherent.
jumps: View rises from the crack to reveal the moss cushion behind it.
risk: Several soft ground materials may blend together.

title: Bonsai Root Pocket
setting: A miniature planter rim where dirt clumps collect in a crack beneath two bonsai leaves, with insects threading through root shadow.
food: Dirt clumps, aphids, ladybugs, bonsai leaves.
interaction: Aphids follow the warm leaf side while ladybugs cross the crack; goo mops one damp section, leaving the rest of the coherent soil film in place.
risk: Layered root shadows may obscure smaller food.

title: Ant Trail Mulch
setting: Miniature mulch bed where a leaf vein forms a bridge over loose soil, with ants carrying crumbs around a fallen flower.
food: Soil crumbs, flower bits, ant-carried seeds, leaf knots, fallen fruit.
interaction: Ant traffic circles the flower and leaves crumbs in its wake; goo rolls into the loop, turning the moving trail into a feeding chain.
risk: Ant carrying behavior needs simple, readable paths.

title: Birdbath Rim Spill
setting: Miniature birdbath rim with algae film, fruit, feather barbs, and water spilling onto soil.
food: Algae flecks, fruit skins, feather barbs, water beads, soft soil clumps.
interaction: The spill carries light scraps downhill while heavier clumps stay; goo rolls along the rim, mopping water and reaching fruit skin.
jumps: The camera tilts over the rim to show the spill path below.
risk: Water must stay coherent while only contacted sections disappear.
